Name: Micah, Son of Merib-baal
Summary: Son of Merib-baal and father of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:34; 1 Chronicles 9:40: Son of Merib-baal and father of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Micah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
